description: This Java class implements a strategy for handling the RetrieveSubject command within a policy persistence context. It retrieves subject information from a specified policy entry and constructs appropriate results or error responses based on the presence of the subject and policy entry.

classes.name: RetrieveSubjectStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles the retrieval of a subject within a policy, implementing the logic to process RetrieveSubject commands and produce corresponding results.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Performs the retrieval logic for the RetrieveSubject command, examining the policy's entries and subjects, and returning success or error results accordingly.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Calculates the next entity tag for the policy entity based on its current state and the specified command, used for versioning or caching.
